predecessor.diagnosis: The only directional scene exposed 1870 real poses, but 14/18 functional annotations were discarded by object-box parent binding and no parent retained an ordinal lattice.
predecessor.information_change: Replace mandatory object-box carrier binding with an outcome-blind local same-action lattice linked to an explicit contextual anchor noun from task text. Keep the active-view thresholds unchanged.

source.dataset: SceneFun3D train split plus ARKitScenes low-resolution ARKit camera trajectory
source.camera_pose_frame: ARKit camera-to-world after official trajectory inversion

selection.ordering: ascending visit_id then video_id from the official one-video CSV
selection.stop_rule: Stop immediately after the first scene containing an admissible contextual-lattice active-view opportunity.

frozen_algorithm.view_selection: Among real trajectory poses that contain every lattice candidate inside the frozen normalized frustum, maximize horizontal span, then minimize median depth, then choose earliest timestamp.
frozen_algorithm.left_right_authority: Camera-frame projected x coordinate from the selected real pose; smaller x is left.
frozen_algorithm.baseline: All same-action candidates in the admitted contextual lattice remain set-valued.

forbidden_after_source_access: read description annot_id values or target membership
choose the anchor, lattice, component, camera pose, or polarity using selector output or evaluator score
change anchor distance, lattice radius, pitch, residual, frustum, depth, span, dominance, or view-ranking thresholds
use RGB gradients, target appearance, sibling target order, or discarded object-box parent assignments
reorder candidates or skip the first eligible scene
claim_boundary: Outcome-blind source admission for a carrier-free contextual functional lattice plus a real-pose active view. It uses public task text, privileged functional labels/centers, privileged 3D contextual anchors, and camera trajectory, but no target IDs or selector outcomes. Passing does not establish RGB proposal quality, learned contextual grounding, online view reachability, tracking, arrival, HANDOFF_READY, product benefit, or safety.
